go/scroll-area.html:
func ScrollAreaExample() *ui.Element {
	scrollArea := ui.NewScrollArea(ui.ScrollAreaRootProps{ViewportSize: func() ui.Extent {
		return ui.Extent{Width: 320, Height: 160}
	}, ContentSize: func() ui.Extent {
		return ui.Extent{Width: 320, Height: 880}
	}})
	return scrollArea.Root().Child(func() *native.Node {
		state := ui.UseScrollAreaState()
		viewport := scrollArea.Viewport().Width(320).Height(160).Overflow("hidden").Child(
			scrollArea.Content(ui.PartProps{Style: func() ui.StyleBuilder {
				return ui.Style().Transform(fmt.Sprintf("translateY(%gpx)", -state().Offset.Y))
			}}).Child(func() *native.Node {
				rows := make([]*ui.Element, 0, 40)
				for index := range 40 {
					rows = append(rows, ui.Text("Row ", index).Height(22))
				}
				return ui.Fragment(rows)
			}),
		)
		scrollbar := scrollArea.Scrollbar(ui.ScrollAreaScrollbarProps{Orientation: "vertical"}).Child(
			scrollArea.Thumb(ui.ScrollAreaThumbProps{Orientation: "vertical"}),
		)
		return ui.Fragment(viewport, scrollbar)
	})
}

func ToastExample() *ui.Element {

	return toast.Provider().Child(func() *native.Node {
		manager := ui.UseToastManager()
		save := ui.Button().Child("Save").OnClick(func() {
			manager.Add(ui.ToastRequest{Title: "Saved", Type: "success"})
		})
		viewport := toast.Viewport().Child(
			ui.For(manager.Toasts, func(item ui.ToastDeclaration, _ func() int) *ui.Element {
				return toast.Root(ui.ToastPartProps{ToastID: item.ID}).Children(
					toast.Title(ui.ToastPartProps{ToastID: item.ID}).Child(item.Title),
					toast.Close(ui.ToastPartProps{ToastID: item.ID}).Child("Dismiss"),
				)
			}, func(item ui.ToastDeclaration) any {
				return item.ID
			}, nil),
		)
		return ui.Fragment(save, viewport)
	})
}

					)
				},

	})
}

go/radio-group.html:
func RadioGroupExample() *ui.Element {
	value, setValue := ui.CreateSignal("system")
	group := ui.NewRadioGroup(ui.RadioGroupProps{Value: func() *string {
		current := value()
		return &current
	}, OnValueChange: func(next string, _ *native.Event) {
		setValue(next)
	}})
	options := make([]*ui.Element, 0, 3)
	for _, value := range []string{"light", "dark", "system"} {
		radio := ui.NewRadio().Value(value)
		options = append(options, radio.Root().Children(
			radio.Indicator(),
			ui.Text(value),
		))
	}
	return group.Root().Children(options)
}

func PopoverExample() *ui.Element {
    popover := ui.NewPopover().Side("bottom").SideOffset(8)
    return popover.Root().Children(
        popover.Trigger().Child("Account"),
        popover.Positioner().Child(
            popover.Popup().Width(240).Padding(16).Children(
                popover.Title().Child("Account"),
                popover.Description().Child("Manage your account settings."),
                popover.Close().Child("Done"),
            ),
        ),
    )
}

    .side(AnchorSide::Bottom)
    .side_offset(8.0);
let mut root = popover.root().child(
    popover.trigger().on_click(toggle).child("Account"),
);
if popover.is_open() {
    root = root.child(popover.positioner().child(
        popover.popup().w(240.0).p(16.0).on_dismiss(dismiss).children([
            popover.title().child("Account"),
            popover.description().child("Manage your account settings."),
            popover.close("Close").on_click(dismiss).child("Done"),
        ]),
    ));
